description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between TFLOPs (trillion floating-point operations) on the x-axis and Loss Ratio (%) on the y-axis for five different configurations of language model inference, including a baseline “Vanilla” method and four variants of the SepLLM approach with varying segment sizes and compression strategies. The x-axis is logarithmic, ranging from 1e7 to 9e8 TFLOPs with tick labels at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis is linear, ranging from 94% to 100% Loss Ratio with major gridlines at 94, 95, 96, 97, 98, 99, and 100. The “Vanilla” line (purple, triangle markers, solid line) remains nearly flat at 100% across all TFLOP values. The “SepLLM (n=64)” line (orange, square markers, solid line) starts at approximately 98.2% at 1e7 TFLOPs, rises to a peak of ~100.2% at 4e8 TFLOPs, then slightly declines to ~99.8% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The “SepLLM (n=128)” line (blue, cross markers, solid line) begins at ~97.0% at 1e7 TFLOPs, increases to ~99.8% by 3e8 TFLOPs, and stabilizes near 99.8–100% thereafter. The “SepLLM (n=64, H)” line (green, diamond markers, solid line) starts at ~97.5% at 1e7 TFLOPs, climbs to ~100% by 3e8 TFLOPs, and remains near 100% with minor fluctuations. The “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” line (red, circle markers, solid line) begins at ~94.0% at 1e7 TFLOPs, rises steeply to ~97.2% at 5e7 TFLOPs, continues increasing to ~99.0% at 2e8 TFLOPs, peaks at ~99.2% at 4e8 TFLOPs, then dips slightly to ~98.5% at 5e8 TFLOPs before stabilizing around 98.8–99.0% through 9e8 TFLOPs.
